question: ____________ members of the State Legislative Council are nominated by the Governor of the State.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1/6**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In the State Legislative Council, **1/6th of the members** are nominated by the Governor.
 
• The Governor nominates members who are persons having special knowledge or practical experience in respect of such matters as literature, science, art, the cooperative movement, and social service.
 
• The nomination of members by the Governor is aimed at ensuring that the Council includes individuals with expertise in various fields.
 
• This provision is a part of the bicameral legislature system in some states of India, providing a mechanism for the inclusion of knowledgeable and experienced individuals in the legislative process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bicameral Legislature**

 
 
• A bicameral legislature is a legislative body with two chambers or houses.
 
• In India, the Parliament at the national level is bicameral, consisting of the Lok Sabha (House of the People) and the Rajya Sabha (Council of States).
 
• Similarly, some states in India have a bicameral legislature, consisting of the State Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) and the State Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad).
 
 
 
• **State Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad)**
 
 
• The State Legislative Council is the upper house in states with a bicameral legislature.
 
• Members of the State Legislative Council are elected and nominated from various constituencies and categories, including graduates, teachers, and local authorities.
 
• The Council acts as a revisory body, providing an additional layer of scrutiny to legislation passed by the State Legislative Assembly.
 
 
 
• **Role of the Governor**
 
 
• The Governor is the constitutional head of the state, appointed by the President of India.
 
• The Governor has various powers and functions, including legislative, executive, and discretionary powers.
 
• One of the legislative functions of the Governor is to nominate members to the State Legislative Council as per the provisions of the Constitution.
